info.title: Resource Allocation & Staffing Management API
info.description: JWT-secured REST API for staffing, employee skills, project allocations, certifications, notifications, and skill-based employee recommendations.

tags.name: Employee
tags.description: Employee management (ADMIN/MANAGER overview). Employees use /api/me for their own data.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Admin management of login accounts (roles, status, password reset, employee link)

tags.name: Recommendations
tags.description: AI-style scoring of employees for a project

tags.name: Bench
tags.description: Active employees with no current allocations

tags.name: Me
tags.description: Personal dashboard for the authenticated employee (their own data only)

tags.name: Allocations
tags.description: Assign employees to projects and track workload

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Aggregate staffing statistics for the overview dashboard

tags.name: Certification
tags.description: Manage employee certifications and expiry status

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Login, refresh and revoke JWT tokens. Accounts are provisioned by admins, not self-registered.

tags.name: Employee Skills
tags.description: Assign skills and proficiency levels to employees

put.summary: Link this user to an employee record

delete.summary: Unlink this user from its employee record

put.summary: Mark a notification as read (own notifications, unless ADMIN/MANAGER)
Update an employee's HR fields (login is managed via /api/users)

delete.summary: Delete an employee and its linked login

get.summary: Get one employee-skill link by id

delete.summary: Remove a skill from an employee

post.summary: Create a new login account (returns a generated temporary password)
Reset a user's password to a new temporary one (revokes active tokens)

get.summary: Get a page of all notifications

post.summary: Create an employee and provision their linked login (returns the temporary password once)

get.summary: List a page of employee-skill links

post.summary: Assign a skill to an employee
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair
Invalidate all tokens previously issued to the authenticated user
Login and receive access + refresh tokens
Create an allocation (assign an employee to a project)

patch.summary: Enable or disable a user (disabling revokes their active tokens)

delete.summary: Delete a user (unlinks any employee first)

get.summary: Per-employee utilization summary with status buckets
Certification counts and lists grouped by status
Get the top-N recommended employees for a project, with score breakdown
Get one notification by id (own notifications, unless ADMIN/MANAGER)
List a page of notifications for a given recipient (own, unless ADMIN/MANAGER)
People currently working on the same projects as me
List all skills for one employee (employees use /api/me/skills)
Aggregate staffing statistics (counts, utilization, certification expiry buckets)
List all certifications for a given employee (employees use /api/me/certifications)
List bench employees (active employees with no active allocations)
List audit log entries, newest first
Get an employee's current workload / utilization (employees use /api/me/workload)
List all allocations for a given employee (employees use /api/me/allocations)
List every employee whose active allocations exceed 100% capacity
